title: Electrical installation not checked in 15 years

mitigation.action: Electrician inspects the fixed installation, the sockets and the earthing and writes a report

known_quirks: Brittle rubber-insulated cables in houses from before 1970
Missing earthing in bathroom and outdoor sockets
Home-made extensions behind panels and in attics
why_hint: DRAFT: The house is over 30 years old and there is no record of an electrical inspection in the last 15 years. Tukes recommends a check of old installations every 15 to 30 years.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: One inspection finds brittle cables and missing earthing before they start a fire or give a shock.
